Method of Attack: Exploiting Android vulnerability StrandHogg to masquerade as legitimate apps
Requesting any permission by disguising as legitimate apps to harvest data or phish credentials
Distributed via malware droppers and downloaders
Using malformed APKs to evade detection
Infecting devices to steal confidential information including microphone, camera, SMS, phone calls, photos, location, contacts, and phone logs
Impacted Systems: Android devices up to and including Android 10
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Android multitasking system vulnerability 'taskAffinity' without rooting
Malware droppers and downloaders distributed via Google Play Store (now removed)
Indicators of Compromise: Malware samples distributed via malware droppers and downloaders removed from Google Play Store
Permission pop-ups without app names, apps asking for unnecessary permissions, UI discrepancies
